claude_only.name: Which identifier scheme is authoritative for this product type, who licenses or issues it, and what is the issuing authority's registered identifier?
At which granularity does this identifier bind — model/type, sub-type variant, packaging level, or a grouping above trade-item identity?
If no external authoritative scheme applies, what internally assigned identifier is used and how is its uniqueness guaranteed?
Is the identity anchor resolvable to a network-retrievable representation, and under whose control is that resolution?
Which declared attributes, when changed, force allocation of a new type identifier rather than a record revision?
From which effective date does a type identifier change apply, and how are in-market goods carrying the previous identifier handled?
Under what conditions, if any, may a retired identifier be reassigned, and what is the enforced quarantine period?
What evidence records the change decision so it can be audited and, if disputed, reversed?
What are the product root, family and type designations, and which of them is the customer-facing name?
Which brand is asserted on this type, who owns that brand, and is it the primary brand for identifier-change purposes?
Which locales are names and descriptions maintained in, and which locale is authoritative when translations conflict?
Can a designation change without changing the type identity, and what approval is required?
For each secondary key, which party and which channel or contract does it apply within?
How are collisions handled when the same secondary key value is used by different parties for different types?
Which legacy keys must be retained after migration, and for how long, to keep historical transactions resolvable?
Which classification schemes is this type assigned in, and what is the code, scheme version and effective date of each assignment?
Who made each classification assignment, and was it self-declared, partner-supplied or authority-verified?
Which single classification is treated as primary for navigation and reporting when schemes disagree?
Is any assignment provisional or a holding value pending a scheme update, and when must it be revisited?
What is the customs nomenclature code for this type, under which HS edition and which national extension?
Which regulatory risk or hazard classes apply to this type, under which legal instrument and jurisdiction?
When the nomenclature edition changes, who re-assesses the code and how is the transition recorded?
Has any classification been challenged or overridden by a customs or regulatory authority, and what is the binding outcome?
Which dictionary definition and version does each declared characteristic bind to?
Which characteristics have no dictionary binding, and what is the plan or justification for leaving them unbound?
Which characteristics are mandatory for this type's classification or regulatory category, and which are optional?
What happens to recorded values when a bound property definition is superseded in a new dictionary release?
What value and unit of measure is declared for each characteristic, and which unit code system is used?
Is each value nominal/declared, a specification limit, or a typical value, and what tolerance applies?
Under which test method, standard and ambient conditions does the declared value hold?
When was each declared value last verified, and when does it expire or require re-testing?
Which properties are the declared variant axes of the group this type belongs to, and what value does this type take on each?
Which variations are represented as separate type identities and which are carried as sub-variant qualifiers under a shared identifier?
Is the product group's membership closed and enumerable, or open and configurable at order time?
Is the group itself ever presented as orderable, and if not, how is that constraint enforced downstream?
Which packaging levels exist for this product, what identifier does each carry, and what is the parent-child containment quantity?
Is each higher packaging level homogeneous, or a pre-defined assortment of different child types?
Which packaging level is the consumer or point-of-sale unit, and which levels are orderable or invoiceable?
What packaging materials and recyclability data are declared for each level?
What is the declared net content of the type, in which unit, and is it a legally declared quantity?
On what basis are the declared dimensions and weights measured — as packaged, as displayed, or as shipped?
What tolerance applies to declared quantities, and at what deviation does a change require a new type identifier?
Do declared quantities differ by target market due to metrology or labelling rules, and how is that represented?
What is the declared material breakdown by mass fraction, origin country and recycled content?
Which substances of concern are present above declared thresholds, and under which regulatory list?
Which bill of material governs the component composition of this type, and at which revision and effectivity?
How was the composition determined — supplier declaration, laboratory analysis or calculation — and what is its confidence?
What is the typed relation to the other product type, and in which direction does it hold?
Under what conditions or configurations does a compatibility assertion hold, and where does it fail?
Which spare parts must remain available for this type, for how long after discontinuation, and under which obligation?
When was each relationship last reviewed, and what invalidates it?
Which type supersedes this one, which did it supersede, and from what effective date?
Is a declared substitution bidirectional or one-way, and in which markets or contracts does it apply?
Was the generation change modelled as a new type identity or as a revision of the existing type, and why?
How and when were affected trading partners notified of the succession or substitution?
Which lifecycle states are defined for a product type in this Dimension, and which transitions are permitted?
Which role may authorise each state transition, and what evidence must accompany it?
How is the record's lifecycle state kept distinct from commercial availability and stock position?
Does each state have an effective time distinct from the time it was recorded, and are both retained?
What is the current product specification version and the current record version, and how are they incremented independently?
How is a change classified as material (affecting product behaviour or compliance) versus editorial (correcting the record)?
Which approval path applies to each change class, and which changes may be applied without approval?
Can the record as it stood at any past instant be reconstructed, and to what granularity?
What are the last-order, last-shipment and end-of-support dates, and how do they differ across markets?
How long must the type record, its passport and its compliance evidence remain accessible after discontinuation, and under which obligation?
If a safety issue emerges after discontinuation, how are affected instances reached from the type record?
Under what conditions may the record be deleted rather than archived, and what tombstone remains?
For which target markets is this type declared, using which country or region code system?
Which attributes take different values per target market, and how is the market-scoped value represented?
Where is the type produced, and is that independent of the markets in which it is placed?
What authorisation, registration or notification is required before the type may be placed on each market?
What is the validity period of each time-scoped assertion, expressed with explicit offsets?
Are event time and observation or ingestion time recorded separately for externally sourced assertions?
How are future-dated changes staged so that consumers see the correct value at the correct time?
What resolves overlapping or contradictory validity periods for the same attribute?
Which parties hold which regulatory roles for this type, in which markets, and with what registered identifiers?
Is the type registered in each required authority registry, and what registry identifier was returned?
How is a change of responsible operator recorded, and what happens to prior registrations and identifiers?
Which regulatory obligations apply to this type per market, and what is the compliance status of each?
Does a passport obligation apply to this type, under which instrument and delegated act, and from what date?
At which granularity is the passport issued for this type — model, batch or item — and why?
What unique URI identifies the passport, who issued it, and where does it resolve?
Which data elements of the passport are public and which are restricted to specific user roles?
For each claim, is it a supplier self-declaration or an independently attested conformity result, and who is the assessment body?
Against which standard, metric and threshold is each claim made, and at which version of that standard?
Which conformity or regulatory markings are applied to the product or its packaging, and on what basis?
Which documents and media constitute the required documentation set for this type, in which locales, and which version of each is current?
When does each attestation expire or require surveillance, and what happens to the claim in the interim?
Which party is authoritative for each attribute group of this record, and on what basis is that authority established?
Which party publishes the record on the authoritative party's behalf, and under what mandate?
When a non-authoritative contributor supplies a conflicting value, which wins and how is the loser preserved?
Which named steward is accountable for the record's completeness and currency, and on what review cycle?
Which access classes apply to which attribute groups, and who may read each class?
Is the type under pre-release embargo, until when, and which attributes are embargoed?
May a recipient redistribute the record or its media, to whom, and under what licence?
What access events must be logged, retained for how long, and made available to whom?
For each asserted value, which party and source system supplied it and by what acquisition method?
Are event time and ingestion time both retained for each assertion, with explicit offsets?
Which values are derived or inferred rather than asserted, and what is the derivation rule and its inputs?
What trust level is assigned to each source, and how does it affect precedence and publication?
Which validation rule sets apply to this record, at which version, and which are blocking versus advisory?
How is completeness measured against the mandatory attribute set implied by classification and market, and what is the current score?
When two sources assert different values for the same attribute, what procedure resolves it and who decides?
Which validation outcomes block publication to each downstream channel?
Which data carriers encode this type's identity, on which packaging levels, and with which encoded content?
How is the web URI for this type constructed, including qualifier ordering and identifier normalisation?
What does the URI resolve to for each requesting role and link type, and who operates the resolver?
When the carrier or its encoded content changes, how are in-market goods with the previous carrier handled?
Which external profiles is this record projected into, at which profile version, and for which consumers?
Which elements cannot be mapped in each direction, and how is the loss recorded rather than silently dropped?
What evidence supports any claim of conformance to an external profile, and who validated it?
Does a round trip through a projection preserve identity, semantics and provenance, and what is verified?

grok_only.name: What is the authoritative class-level GTIN for this catalog item, in which encoding (GTIN-8, GTIN-12, GTIN-13 or GTIN-14), and which issuing GS1 Company Prefix allocated it?
Does this identifier identify the class of all identical trade items rather than a serialised instance, lot, logistic unit or restricted-circulation number?
Which packaging hierarchy level does this GTIN identify (base consumer unit, inner pack, case, pallet trade item) and what are the sibling GTINs at other levels?
What is the canonical GS1 Digital Link URI for this class (HTTPS, 14-digit AI 01, no serial/lot/CPV path) and is it the id.gs1.org form or a brand-owner resolver URI?
What manufacturer part number and brand jointly identify this type when a GTIN is absent or as a secondary key?
Which merchant SKU, ASIN or other catalog keys exist, who assigned each, and in which catalog namespace are they unique?
Is there a Global Model Number or other model/family identifier, and does each GTIN associate with at most one GMN?
What GPC Segment, Family, Class and Brick (and brick attribute values) classify this GTIN in the version of GPC used for GDSN?
What UNSPSC commodity code and Harmonized System heading/subheading (plus any national tariff extension) apply, and for which process (procurement versus customs)?
Which classification schemes are intentionally absent because they are out of industry scope (for example GPC on a pure service) and who decided that?
Is any mapping between GPC, UNSPSC, HS or eCl@ss asserted, and if so is it an official correspondence or a local heuristic?
Which characterization or categorization class in which dictionary (IRDI or equivalent) does this catalog item instantiate?
Which properties are mandatory in the identification guide or application class, and which observed values with units satisfy them?
Does the exchanged characteristic-data message conform to ISO 8000-110 syntax, semantic encoding and the cited data specification?
What are the governed short and long names of this catalog item, in which languages, and which name is canonical for trading-partner exchange?
Which brand and manufacturer organisations are associated with this type, and is the brand owner the GTIN allocator?
Has language-only packaging or a primary brand change occurred such that trading partners must distinguish a new GTIN?
What declared net content, dimensions, weight and other type-level measurements apply, with units and whether each is a point value or a range?
What declared formulation, ingredients or functionality define this type, and which of those declarations are legally required on pack?
Would a proposed change to net content, dimensions, gross weight, formulation or functionality require a new GTIN under the GTIN Management Standard and any stricter local regulation?
What country of origin, assembly or last processing is declared at type level, and is it actually invariant across plants and lots?
Which product group or base model does this catalog item belong to, and which dimensions (variesBy) distinguish its siblings?
What sibling catalog items (GTINs) share the group, and which features are inherited versus locally overridden?
Which product models are predecessor or successor of this type, and was the predecessor discontinued?
What is the base consumer-unit GTIN and how many of those units are contained in each higher-level trade-item GTIN?
Has pack or case quantity changed such that a new higher-level GTIN is mandatory while the base unit may remain?
Is this catalog item a predefined assortment or bundle of other catalog items, and which child GTINs and quantities does it contain?
Is this catalog item a new product (not previously in the brand owner's portfolio) or a change to an existing in-market product?
Which GTIN Management rules and guiding principles fired for this version, and did any local regulation require a stricter change?
When was the GTIN assigned (event time) versus when was that assignment ingested into this Dimension (observation time)?
Is this record being used to identify a non-new, refurbished or returned trade item, which this standard forbids?
Who is the GTIN allocator / brand owner, who is the manufacturer or device labeler if different, and under which GS1 Company Prefix or FDA-accredited issuing agency was the type key issued?
Has this GTIN been withdrawn, was it ever produced, and is reuse forbidden or limited to a documented exception?
Which roles may create, patch or mark-deleted this catalog item, and is hard deletion of an allocated GTIN prohibited in favour of discontinued status?
Which agent generated or revised this master-data entity, through which activity, and what prior entity was it derived from?
If this type is a medical device, what is the UDI Device Identifier (and issuing agency) and the Basic UDI-DI/GMN, and are production identifiers excluded from this record?
Which certifications, marks or energy classes apply at type level, who issued them, and did add/remove of a mark require a new GTIN?
What GUDID or equivalent registry fields (brand name, version/model, GMDN, package count, premarket number) are bound to this type?
Does an FDA UDI exception, alternative or other regional exemption apply so that this type has no UDI-DI?
In which catalogs, data pools or public pages is this type published, under which identifier, and what is the publication status?
What check-digit, prefix, dictionary-conformance and completeness evidence supports this record, and when was it last validated?
Who may read, export or patch this catalog item at bundle, layer, finding and artefact scope, and which adult, investigational or confidential exceptions apply?
How long must the identifier and master data be retained after discontinuation so that non-reuse and traceability are preserved?
Which item-instance records (serialised or otherwise) does this catalog item classify, and is the edge always class-to-instance rather than lot-to-instance?
Which engineering BOMs list this catalog item as a component or assembly type, and at what quantity at the type level?
Which other catalog items are declared accessories, spares, consumables, related or similar, and in which direction?
Which external vocabularies is this record aligned to (schema.org ProductModel, GS1 trade item, ISO 22745 item, IEC 61360 class, FDA DI), and what conflicts are recorded rather than hidden?

requirements: Resolve every provider-only bundle, layer and finding against primary evidence.
Resolve the model boundary and entry kind before accepting structure.
Verify live URLs and version pins for all accepted sources.
Record every rejected and deferred node with a reason.
Do not publish while any critical conflict remains unresolved.
